ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping District, symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-J in the
area bound by:

West 16" Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Lawndale Avenue; a line 72
feet south of and parallel to West 16" Street; and South Lawndale Avenue,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Monique L. S'
Alderwoman, \24" > Ward

Common Address:
1601-1607 S. Lawndale Avenue
